Read as colloquial kuffiyye, with doubled f and y. The same scarf is more commonly written كوفية, and pronunciations vary.
A natural Palestinian congratulatory formula. البيت has long ee, and الجديد normally loses the initial short vowel of MSA jadiid.

شروق is an ordinary conversational term for sunrise. In this common-noun use, urban ق can be realized as a glottal stop.
بيجي علي is a natural way to ask whether clothing fits. ق in قميص is glottalized, and علي has final doubled y.
Literally, there is something wrong. إشي is the everyday Palestinian word for something, and ط is emphatic.

This plural is routinely used in Palestinian conversation for fruit or fruits. The middle vowel is long aa.
جبس names plaster or gypsum and is also used for a plaster cast. The supplied spelling has non-emphatic س.

A common adjective meaning dry, especially dry or hardened material or food. It has long aa.

A standard Palestinian food-related well-wish, said around a meal. صحتين has long ee, and عافية is contracted to 3aafye.
